why: Image 1 reads as a real storefront shot at blue hour: the facade, the tree, the pavement sheen and the warm room glowing through glass with reflections on it all hang together, though the room's own light is a small part of the frame. Image 2 has a richer interior with depth, but the right half falls apart into muddled panels, a smeared pillar texture and a floating orb lamp, and heavy noise in the shadows gives it away as a render.
